flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3002/app then Verify the heading contains "CloudScale AI Inference Gateway" and Active keys reads "2 Keys".
Click the button "Generate Production API Key" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers the button; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Action status displays "KEY_GENERATED_HEALTHY" and Active keys reads "3 Keys".

remark: assert: the heading contains "CloudScale AI Inference Gateway"
click: Clicking Generate Production API Key button
wait: Waiting stop after the required button click did not reach its target

summary:
The agent clicked an area near the Available quota panel instead of the visible Generate Production API Key button. The button was available, but the click did not reach it.
Fix the click targeting so the mouse lands within the visible Generate Production API Key button, then rerun the check.
one_liner: The automated mouse click missed the Generate Production API Key button, so no key was created.

verdict.root_cause: The agent clicked an area near the Available quota panel instead of the visible Generate Production API Key button. The button was available, but the click did not reach it.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome by sending its single allowed mouse click to the wrong location. The screenshot marker is positioned in the Available quota card rather than on the Generate Production API Key button, and the run rules prohibited retrying or working around the missed click. Nothing in the evidence shows that the product ignored a correctly delivered click.
verdict.bug_title: API-key generation click targeted the wrong page area
verdict.suggestion: Fix the click targeting so the mouse lands within the visible Generate Production API Key button, then rerun the check.
